command:
set -euo pipefail
LA="$HOME/local-agent"
CTRL="$HOME/agent-workspace/repos/esp32-c6-zigbee/control"
WT="/private/tmp/local-agent-chat-bridge-next-preview-v37"
BR="v4.13.2-staging"
EXPECTED="838fb36ec204c8f9e13057096a0b95f58126df0f"
test "$(git -C "$LA" branch --show-current)" = main
test "$(git -C "$LA" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
test -z "$(git -C "$LA" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
git -C "$LA" fetch --quiet origin main
test "$(git -C "$LA" rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED"
test ! -e "$WT"
git -C "$LA" worktree add -b "$BR" "$WT" origin/main
python3 "$CTRL/.agent/patches/v37_chat_bridge_next_preview.py" "$WT"
cd "$WT"
git diff --check
node --check chat_bridge/service_worker.js
node --check chat_bridge/service_worker.test.js
node --check chat_bridge/popup.js
node chat_bridge/control_protocol.test.js
node chat_bridge/bridge_state.test.js
node chat_bridge/service_worker.test.js
python3 -m json.tool chat_bridge/manifest.json >/dev/null
git add chat_bridge/service_worker.js chat_bridge/service_worker.test.js chat_bridge/popup.js chat_bridge/manifest.json
git commit -m "Improve Chat Bridge wake schedule visibility"
git push -u origin "$BR"
echo "CANDIDATE=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "PRODUCTION_HEAD=$(git -C "$LA" rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "PRODUCTION_DIRTY=$(git -C "$LA" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
